headline.en: MSCI: private credit steady in Q2 2026 as private equity rebounds
headline.zh: MSCI：2026年第二季度私人信贷保持稳定，私募股权反弹

summary.en: Private credit held steady in the second quarter of 2026 according to MSCI research, while private equity rebounded. The MSCI Global Private Credit Closed-End Fund Index gained 1.7 per cent in the second quarter, up from 0.9 per cent in the first quarter. Opportunistic lending led the group.
summary.zh: 根据MSCI的研究，2026年第二季度私人信贷保持稳定，而私募股权出现反弹。MSCI Global Private Credit Closed-End Fund Index在第二季度上涨1.7%，高于第一季度的0.9%。机会型贷款在该组别中领先。

items.source_headline: Private credit steady as private equity rebounds

reason.en: Index data shows a modest quarter-on-quarter improvement in private credit returns, an incremental sector datapoint with no entity-specific impact.
reason.zh: 指数数据显示私人信贷回报环比小幅改善，属于行业层面的增量数据，无特定机构影响。

items.relevance_reason: Quarterly MSCI index data on private credit performance informs the return environment for tracked credit strategies.
